1.text: Uwiteka abwira Mose ati “Wibārize ibisate by'amabuye bibiri bisa n'ibya mbere, nanjye ndandika kuri ibyo bisate amagambo yari ku bya mbere wamennye.

2.text: Ejo mu gitondo uzabe witeguye, uzamuke umusozi wa Sinayi mu gitondo umpagararire imbere ku mutwe wawo.

3.text: Ntihazagire uwo muzamukana, ntihazaboneke umuntu kuri uwo musozi wose, imikumbi n'amashyo bye kurisha imbere yawo.”

4.text: Mose abāza ibisate by'amabuye bibiri bisa n'ibya mbere, azinduka kare mu gitondo azamuka umusozi wa Sinayi uko Uwiteka yamutegetse, afashe mu maboko bya bisate by'amabuye byombi.

5.text: Uwiteka amanukira muri cya gicu ahagararanayo na we, yivuga mu izina ko ari Uwiteka.

6.text: Uwiteka anyura imbere ye arivuga ati “Uwiteka, Uwiteka, Imana y'ibambe n'imbabazi, itinda kurakara ifite kugira neza kwinshi n'umurava mwinshi,

7.text: igumanira abantu imbabazi ikageza ku buzukuruza babo b'ibihe igihumbi, ibababarira gukiranirwa n'ibicumuro n'ibyaha. Ntitsindishiriza na hato abo gutsindwa, ihōra abana gukiranirwa kwa ba se ikageza ku buzukuru, n'abuzukuruza n'ubuvivi.”

8.text: Mose yihuta gucurika umutwe yunamye yikubita hasi.

9.text: Aramubwira ati “Mwami, ubwo none nkugiriyeho umugisha gendera hagati muri twe Mwami, kuko ari ubwoko butagonda ijosi. Ubabarire gukiranirwa kwacu n'ibyaha byacu, utwemere uduhindure umwandu wawe.”

10.text: Uwiteka aravuga ati “Dore ndasezerana isezerano: nzakorera ibitangaza imbere y'ubwoko bwawe bwose, bitigeze gukorwa mu isi yose cyangwa mu ishyanga ryose. Abantu bose bakugose bazabona icyo Uwiteka akora, kuko nzagukoresha ibiteye ubwoba.

11.text: Ujye witondera icyo ngutegeka uyu munsi: dore nzirukana Abamori n'Abanyakanāni, n'Abaheti n'Abaferizi, n'Abahivi n'Abayebusi baguhunge.

12.text: Wirinde ntuzasezerane isezerano na bene igihugu ujyamo, rye kuba nk'umutego hagati muri mwe,

13.text: ahubwo muzasenye ibicaniro byabo, mutembagaze inkingi z'amabuye bubatse, muteme mutsinde ibishushanyo bya Ashera babaje.

14.text: Kuko udakwiriye kugira indi mana yose usenga, kuko Uwiteka witwa Ufuha, ari Imana ifuha.

15.text: “Wirinde gusezerana isezerano na bene igihugu, kugira ngo ubwo bazatambira ibigirwamana basambana, hatazagira ukurarika ukarya ku ntonorano ye,

16.text: kandi ugashyingira abahungu bawe abakobwa babo, kugira ngo ubwo abo bakobwa bazatambira ibigirwamana byabo, batazoshya abahungu bawe kubirarikira.

18.text: “Ujye uziririza iminsi mikuru y'imitsima itasembuwe. Mu minsi irindwi ujye urya imitsima itasembuwe uko nagutegetse, mu gihe cyategetswe cyo mu kwezi Abibu, kuko ari ko waviriyemo muri Egiputa.

19.text: “Uburiza bwose ni ubwanjye, ubw'ingabo bwo mu matungo yawe yose, mu mashyo no mu mikumbi.

20.text: Uburiza bw'indogobe uzabucunguze umwana w'intama, nudashaka kuyicungura, uzayivune ijosi. Imfura z'abahungu bawe zose uzazicungure.“Ntihakagire umuntu uza ubusa imbere yanjye.

21.text: “Mu minsi itandatu ujye ukora, ariko ku wa karindwi ujye uruhuka, no mu ihinga no mu isarura ujye uwuruhukaho. 5.13-14

22.text: “Kandi ujye uziririza umunsi mukuru ukurikira amasabato arindwi, uw'umuganura w'isarura ry'ingano, kandi ujye uziririza umunsi mukuru w'isarura rya byose wo ku iherezo ry'umwaka.

23.text: “Uko umwaka utashye, abagabo bo muri mwe bose bajye baboneka imbere y'Umwami Uwiteka Imana y'Abisirayeli, ibihe bitatu.

24.text: Kuko nzakwirukanira amahanga akaguhunga, nkāgūra ingabano zawe, kandi nta wuzifuza igihugu cyawe, nujya ujya kuboneka imbere y'Uwiteka Imana yawe ibihe bitatu, uko umwaka utashye.

25.text: “Ntugaturane amaraso y'igitambo ntambiwe n'umutsima wasembuwe, kandi igitambo cyo ku munsi mukuru wa Pasika cye kurara.

26.text: “Umuganura w'ibibanje kwera mu butaka bwawe, ujye uwuzana mu nzu y'Uwiteka Imana yawe.“Ntugatekeshe umwana w'ihene amahenehene ya nyina.”

27.text: Uwiteka abwira Mose ati “Iyandikire ayo magambo, kuko isezerano nsezeranye nawe n'Abisirayeli, rihagaze kuri ayo magambo.”

28.text: Amaranayo n'Uwiteka iminsi mirongo ine n'amajoro mirongo ine, atarya umutsima atanywa amazi. Uwiteka yandika kuri bya bisate by'amabuye amagambo y'isezerano. Ni yo ya mategeko uko ari icumi.

29.text: Mose amanuka umusozi Sinayi afashe mu maboko ibyo bisate byombi biriho Ibihamya, nuko amanutse uwo musozi ntiyamenya yuko mu maso he harabagiranishijwe n'Uwo bavuganye.

30.text: Aroni n'Abisirayeli bose barebye Mose babona mu maso he harabagirana, batinya kumwigira hafi.

31.text: Mose arabahamagara, Aroni n'abatware b'iteraniro ryabo basubira aho ari, Mose ababwira amagambo.

32.text: Nyuma Abisirayeli bose bamwigira hafi, abategeka ibyo Uwiteka yamubwiriye byose ku musozi wa Sinayi.

33.text: Mose amaze kuvugana na bo, atwikira mu maso he.

34.text: Kandi uko Mose yajyaga imbere y'Uwiteka kuvugana na we, yikuragaho icyo gitwikirizo akageza aho asohokera, agasohoka akabwira Abisirayeli ibyo yategetswe.

35.text: Abisirayeli bakareba mu maso ha Mose bakabona harabagirana, Mose agasubizaho cya gitwikirizo, akageza aho yongerera kuvugana n'Uwiteka.
